items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I didn't know Jimmy Dupree wrote the right to this.

ctx.x: I used to always play it because I liked it, you know. And then I just added a part to it. Isn't that strange? I didn't know Jimmy Dupree wrote the right to this. As a matter of fact, I wasn't sure that it was published. That's the part I play. Who's playing that, I wonder? Allman. Oh, he's playing it himself. Allman Howard. 된된 You all don't have a piano here, huh? No, not in this building. Yeah. This is the part that I play.
Well, I'm going to play that piano. He's good.
